notes: National rules, with the regional tax rates of Madeira and the Azores.

items.name: Approval of the Annual Accounts
items.rule: Within 3 months after financial year end
items.description: The shareholders approve the accounts and the allocation of profit.

items.name: Corporate Income Tax Return (Modelo 22) and Payment
items.rule: Last day of the 5th month after financial year end (31 May for a calendar year)
items.description: Filed on the Portal das Finanças; the municipal surcharge (derrama) is settled with it.

items.name: Corporate Income Tax Payments on Account
items.rule: July, September and 15 December (calendar financial year)
items.applies: Companies and branches with tax assessed the year before
items.description: Three payments based on the previous year's tax.

items.name: Simplified Business Information (IES / Annual Declaration)
items.rule: 15th day of the 7th month after financial year end (15 July for a calendar year)
items.applies: Companies, branches and sole proprietors with organised accounts
items.description: One filing that delivers the annual accounts to the tax authority, the Commercial Registry, the statistics office and the Bank of Portugal.

items.name: Central Register of Beneficial Owners (RCBE) — Annual Confirmation
items.rule: Annual confirmation with the IES; changes within 30 days
items.description: Filed online with the Institute of Registries and Notary.
items.authority: Instituto dos Registos e do Notariado (IRN)

items.name: Personal Income Tax Return (Modelo 3)
items.description: Business income is reported in Annex B (simplified regime) or Annex C (organised accounts).

items.name: Self-Employed Quarterly Social Security Declaration
items.rule: End of January, April, July and October
items.description: Declares the previous quarter's income, which sets the monthly contributions.

items.name: Monthly Communication of Invoices (SAF-T / e-Fatura)
items.description: Invoices issued are reported to the tax authority.

items.name: VAT Return (monthly)
items.rule: 20th of the second following month, with payment by the 25th
items.applies: VAT-registered businesses with turnover of €650,000 or more
items.description: Filed on the Portal das Finanças.

items.name: VAT Return (quarterly)
items.rule: 20 May, 20 August, 20 November and 20 February, with payment by the 25th
items.description: Filed on the Portal das Finanças.

items.name: Leaving the VAT Exemption (article 53)
items.rule: Declaration of changes in January of the year after the turnover limit is passed (at once if it is passed by more than 25%)
items.applies: Small businesses under the VAT exemption
items.description: VAT is then charged and periodic returns begin.

items.name: Monthly Statement of Remuneration (DMR) to the Tax Authority and Social Security
items.description: Reports each employee's pay, tax withheld and contributions.
items.authority: Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira (AT) / Segurança Social

items.name: Payroll Withholding Tax and Social Security Contributions
items.description: Tax withheld is paid to the tax authority and contributions to Social Security.
items.authority: Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira (AT) / Segurança Social

items.name: Annual Employment Report (Relatório Único)
items.description: The annual report on staff, pay, training and working conditions.

items.name: Transfer Pricing File
items.rule: Prepared by the 15th day of the 7th month after financial year end
items.applies: Companies with income of €10 million or more and related-party transactions
items.description: Large taxpayers submit the file; others keep it available.

items.name: IRC at the Madeira Regional Rate (Modelo 22, Annex C)
items.rule: With the Modelo 22: last day of the 5th month after financial year end
items.applies: Companies based in Madeira, or with income from more than one region
items.description: Madeira applies its own reduced corporate tax rates; a company with turnover in more than one region splits the tax between them in Annex C.
items.authority: Autoridade Tributária e Assuntos Fiscais da Região Autónoma da Madeira (AT-RAM)

items.name: VAT at Madeira Rates — Regional Annex to the VAT Return
items.applies: VAT-registered businesses with transactions located in Madeira and in another region
items.description: Madeira has lower VAT rates than the mainland; transactions in each region are shown in the return's regional annex.
items.authority: Autoridade Tributária e Assuntos Fiscais da Região Autónoma da Madeira (AT-RAM)

items.name: IRC at the the Azores Regional Rate (Modelo 22, Annex C)
items.rule: With the Modelo 22: last day of the 5th month after financial year end
items.applies: Companies based in the Azores, or with income from more than one region
items.description: the Azores applies its own reduced corporate tax rates; a company with turnover in more than one region splits the tax between them in Annex C.
items.authority: Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira / Região Autónoma dos Açores

items.name: VAT at the Azores Rates — Regional Annex to the VAT Return
items.applies: VAT-registered businesses with transactions located in the Azores and in another region
items.description: the Azores has lower VAT rates than the mainland; transactions in each region are shown in the return's regional annex.
items.authority: Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira / Região Autónoma dos Açores
